newsitem.title: USA: Universal Forest acquires Hi-Tek Forest.
newsitem.headline: Universal Forest acquires Hi-Tek Forest.

text.p: Universal Forest Products Inc said Tuesday it completed the acquisition of privately held Hi-Tek Forest Products Inc, a manufacturer of roof and floor trusses for factory manufactured housing, as well as products for industrial customers.

Structured as an asset purchase, the $10.7 million acquisition price includes property, plant, equipment, accounts receivable, inventory and a non-compete agreement with the seller, Alpine Engineered Products Inc of Pompano Beach, Florida.

"We anticipate the acquisition will be accretive to future earnings per share, and will enable us to expand our presence and market share in the manufactured housing industry," Universal Forest chief executive William Currie said in a statement.
The acquisition was announced on September 11.
